description: Send, manage, and replay ntfy push notifications via MCP.
name: io.github.cyanheads/ntfy-mcp-server

environmentVariables.description: JSON array of `{ baseUrl, authToken? | authUsername?+authPassword? }` entries — one per ntfy server. First entry is the default base. Auth is scoped to the entry's `baseUrl`; per-call `base_url` overrides that match a registered base forward that server's auth. Takes precedence over the single-server NTFY_BASE_URL / NTFY_AUTH_* shorthand.
environmentVariables.name: NTFY_SERVERS

environmentVariables.description: Single-server shorthand — base URL of the ntfy server (no trailing slash). Used when NTFY_SERVERS is unset.
environmentVariables.name: NTFY_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Topic used when a tool call omits `topic`. Treat the topic name as a secret — anyone who knows it can publish or subscribe.
environmentVariables.name: NTFY_DEFAULT_TOPIC

environmentVariables.description: Bearer access token (`tk_…`) for the single-server shorthand. Mutually exclusive with NTFY_AUTH_USERNAME / NTFY_AUTH_PASSWORD.
environmentVariables.name: NTFY_AUTH_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Basic-auth username for the single-server shorthand — must be set together with NTFY_AUTH_PASSWORD.
environmentVariables.name: NTFY_AUTH_USERNAME

environmentVariables.description: Basic-auth password for the single-server shorthand — must be set together with NTFY_AUTH_USERNAME.
environmentVariables.name: NTFY_AUTH_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.description: Max retry attempts for transient upstream failures (5xx, network, 429).
environmentVariables.name: NTFY_MAX_RETRIES

environmentVariables.description: When true, a per-call `base_url` override must resolve to a public address and its redirects are not followed. Servers registered under NTFY_SERVERS / NTFY_BASE_URL are exempt. Turn it on where callers you do not control can reach the server.
environmentVariables.name: NTFY_BLOCK_PRIVATE_HOSTS

environmentVariables.description: HTTP session model: 'auto', 'stateful', or 'stateless'. 'auto' resolves to 'stateful'. Keep it stateful — the consent prompt on destructive and outbound calls is a multi-round-trip request that a 2025-era HTTP client can only complete over a live session.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_SESSION_MODE

environmentVariables.description: The hostname for the HTTP server.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST

environmentVariables.description: The port to run the HTTP server on.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_PORT

environmentVariables.description: The endpoint path for the MCP server.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_ENDPOINT_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').
environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL

environmentVariables.description: Directory for file-based logs (Node only; ignored on Workers).
environmentVariables.name: LOGS_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Enable OpenTelemetry instrumentation (spans, metrics, completion logs).
environmentVariables.name: OTEL_ENABLED
